# KkthnxUI Forever

A clean, minimalist interface replacement for World of Warcraft Forever.

This is the Forever edition of KkthnxUI. It only supports the Forever client (Interface 16001) and is developed on its own, apart from the Retail edition.

## Install

Copy the `KkthnxUI` folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.

Log in and type `/kk` to open the options.

## What it covers

- Unit frames for player, target, target of target, pet, focus, boss, party and raid
- Swing timer, shaman totems, PvP flag icon and hunter pet happiness
- Castbars with interrupt colouring
- Action bars with pet, stance and possess bars
- Player buffs and debuffs, unit frame auras and nameplate auras
- Nameplates
- Bags and bank with categories, search and a bag bar
- Micro menu, minimap, tooltips, chat, world map tweaks and a quest tracker skin
- Character and inspect frame skin with slot item levels and enchant warnings
- Automation and quality of life modules, each one optional

## Commands

- `/kk` opens the options
- `/kk test` shows every unit frame with your own data so you can position them
- `/kk swingtest` runs the swing bars on a loop so you can watch and place them
- `/kk afktest` opens the AFK screen so you can see it without going AFK
- `/kk questtest` shows the quest item button so you can place it
- `/kk proctest` lights a few bar 1 buttons with the proc glow so you can check its look
- `/kkdebug` lists the debug streams

## Reporting problems

Open an issue and include your build number and the error text. An error catcher such as Sentinel makes that easy.

## Credits

Written by Josh "Kkthnx" Russell. Bundled libraries keep their own licenses, including oUF, LibCustomGlow and LibSharedMedia. The action buttons use LibActionButtonKit, our own library in `Libraries/LibActionButtonKit-1.0`.

# KkthnxUI Forever

## [1.1.2](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/tree/1.1.2) (2026-11-27)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/compare/1.1.1...1.1.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/releases)

- Bump the version to 1.1.2  
- Regroup the options window and add the settings for this release  
    World Map gets its own page, Group Tools moves to Gameplay, focus click to Unit Frames and the GCD bar to Cooldowns, and the QoL and Nameplate pages are split into clearer cards. Buttons in a card sit two to a row when their labels fit, NEW tags sit beside card titles, and option labels use US spelling.  
- Show the arrival time under the navigation distance and fade the maps while moving  
    An Arrive in line under the on-screen distance estimates how long until you get there. The world map and the Shift+M zone map can fade while you move, replacing the game's own fade, and the zone map gets our skin and a scale option.  
- Fix the AFK screen date and away time and stop the buff canceller reading secret auras  
    The date uses the full date month names with the month number the format expects, time away is counted up to logout, and the buff canceller checks that the aura update can be read before touching it.  
- Change the master volume with Ctrl and the mouse wheel over the minimap  
- Preview the power a cast will cost on the player frame  
- Add class and role icons to friendly name-only plates and keep quest markers by the name  
    Friendly player plates show the class icon beside the name, or the tank or healer icon for group roles. The quest marker follows the name when the bar is hidden, and nameplate widgets stay under the plate when the game hands it a different unit frame.  
- Put the tooltip back in its corner inside instances and mark ranged damage roles  
    Corner In Dungeons and PvP keeps the cursor tooltip out of group content, and the role icon on unit tooltips shows a ranged damage icon for hunters, mages, priests and warlocks.  
- Show the total ammo in your bags on an equipped quiver or ammo pouch  
- Leave group loot to the roll, add a solo bind on pickup confirm and an interact icons option  
    Faster Auto Loot skips items at or above the loot threshold in a group and items with no bag room, leaving them in the loot window. Confirm Bind on Pickup Solo skips the question while not grouped. Interact Icons sets the game's interact key icons to Show All and puts your old choice back when turned off.  
- Show quest XP, leveling stats and optional hover text on the experience bar  
    A gold layer shows the XP of quests ready to hand in, the tooltip adds XP per hour, time and kills to level, the bar text can show only on hover, and the text size fits thin bars.  
- Prefer quest rewards that upgrade worn gear and announce objective progress  
    Prefer Upgrades picks a reward that beats what is equipped, going by an upgrade addon's verdict when one is loaded, else the same item type with a higher item level or an empty slot. Quest Announce can also tell the group when objectives finish or on every step.  
- Sell flagged junk, cap sales at the buyback list and optionally sell outgrown gear  
    The auto sell also sells items flagged as junk, Safe Selling stops at the 12 buyback slots per visit, outgrown soulbound gear up to rare can be sold below a set share of the equipped item level, and each run prints a short summary.  
- Skin the game's damage meter with our bars, borders, font and header  
- Cut long macro names short inside the action button  
- Add a quest item button with a keybind and /kk questtest  
    One button holds the usable item of the nearest quest in your zone, with a keybind under KkthnxUI in the game's key bindings. Bindings.xml also adds the Sell Junk key used by the junk seller.  
- Line the proc glow up with the button border and add /kk proctest  
    The Pixel ring now sits on the border line above it, the Default style's ant ring is sized to the border, and /kk proctest lights a few bar 1 buttons to check the look.  
- Add chat helpers: sent line memory, longer scrollback, /cls, /find, short loot lines, channel color memory and levels beside names  
    Sent lines are kept per character so the edit box arrows reach the last session, every window keeps 500 lines by default, /cls and /clsall clear windows, /find shows matching lines in the copy window, loot, money and XP lines can be shortened, a channel keeps its color when its number changes, and players whose level is known can show it beside their name.  
- Add Discord guild chat to the General tab in the chat setup  
    Also drops a message group and a setting that do not exist on Forever.  
- Fix the setup wizard's camera and combat text tweaks and stop it reopening after a close  
    Combat text now uses the \_v2 setting Forever has, the camera distance tops out at the game's own 2.0, and closing the window counts as done so it is not shown again at every login.  
- Add shared helpers for game format strings, gear slots, uncollected looks and bar font sizes  
    K.FormatToPattern turns a game format string into a pattern, K.GearSlotsFor maps an equip location to its slots, K.IsUncollectedAppearance checks the transmog collection and K.FitFontSize keeps bar text inside thin bars.  
- Keep the defaults when a saved setting has the wrong type and keep the UI scale in range  
    A setting saved with a different type than its default, from an old, edited or damaged save, now falls back to the default at login, the same rule profile import uses. The UI scale is clamped to 0.4 to 1.15 so a bad value cannot break the interface.  
- Keep the pet level line on companion and wild pet tooltips  
    The level line rewrite expected "Level 5 Beast" and put the unit level,  
    standing and creature type in front of the client's "Pet Level 1  
    Critter" line, which gave "60 Friendly Non-combat Pet Pet Level 1  
    Critter". Companions and wild battle pets now keep the client's line.  
- Add an AFK screen with the character, session numbers and missed messages  
    Going AFK hides the interface for a full-screen view. The camera turns  
    slowly, the character waves and now and then plays an emote, and the  
    clock and date sit top left. A card bottom left shows this session's  
    time online and away, gold, experience rate and time to level, quests  
    and deaths. The panel on the right shows the time away, class and  
    faction icons, location, gold, durability, bags, experience and the  
    whispers and guild chat that came in.  
    It never opens in combat, while dead or in a cinematic, and waits while  
    casting or typing. Any key brings the interface back, and it steps aside  
    for combat, ready checks, summons, invites, trades and the logout  
    countdown. Options sit under Misc, and /kk afktest opens it to look at.  
- Skin the shard transfer toast and give close buttons a fuller X  
    The shard transfer countdown now has the UI's gradient and border, and its  
    minimize button uses a new fold button: the close button's square with the  
    plain button gradient and a gold minus or plus that follows the toast. Both  
    are pinned to the chat holder with the 6px gap, since the game's own anchor  
    put the button off the left edge of the screen.  
    The close button's X now spans its square corner to corner. Its bars and the  
    fold glyph share one stroke and are drawn off the pixel grid, so a fractional  
    stroke draws at its real weight instead of rounding to a whole pixel.  
- Work around the gamepad pet button flash error for hunters and warlocks  
    The game's pet flyout button flashes its popup's attack button, but the  
    popup is only attached once the flyout has opened. A pet attacking before

# KkthnxUI Forever

## [1.1.1](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/tree/1.1.1) (2026-11-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/compare/1.1.0...1.1.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/releases)

- Bump to 1.1.1  
- Run setup once per character  
    The chat windows and game settings setup applies are saved per character, so  
    each character now gets it once. The account wide version stays for What's New.  
- Hide creature flee emotes and grey trail options a style does not use  
    A new chat option, on by default, drops the "attempts to run away in fear!"  
    emote. The repeat spam filter restarts its window on each repeat so steady  
    spam stays hidden. Cursor trail settings grey out with a reason while the  
    chosen style does not use them.  
- Keep enemy targets in melee at full alpha for low level hunters  
    Auto Shot reads out of range inside its minimum range and Wing Clip comes at  
    level 12, so a hunter in melee faded the target. An enemy within duel distance  
    now counts as in range, which the game still answers in combat.  
- Put ammo free slots under Ammunition and redraw the unusable tint after a level up  
    A quiver or ammo pouch free slot now sits after the ammo it holds. Empty slots  
    show a greyed bag icon over the dark blank slot art, the backpack icon for  
    general bags and the bag's own icon for a special bag. The unusable gear verdict  
    is cleared a moment after a level up or new skill and the open bags redrawn, so  
    a stale red tint no longer stays until a reload.  
- Show surnames on unit frames and add a first name only option  
    On Forever UnitName returns the first name and then the surname, not a  
    realm. The name tags only read the first value, so surnames never  
    showed. Unit, party and nameplate names now show the full name, or the  
    first name alone with the new First Name Only option. Raid frames keep  
    the first name since they cut names to a few letters.  
    The tooltip read the surname as a realm and appended it again, giving  
    "Kkthnx Pewpew-Pewpew". Forever has no realm in that slot, so the Show  
    Realm Name option is removed. The nameplate quest owner check now  
    matches your name with or without the surname.  
- Keep faded action bars faded when they are laid out again  
    A mouseover or combat fade bar jumped to full alpha and faded back out  
    on every re-layout, such as a settings change or a mover drop. It now  
    carries on from its current alpha.  
    The tooltip target line marked anyone sharing your name as you, so it  
    now compares units. Pressing Shift over a unit no longer rebuilds the  
    tooltip when the item level line is off, which also dropped the hint  
    line unit frames add.

# KkthnxUI Forever

## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/tree/1.1.0) (2026-11-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/compare/1.0.3...1.1.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/releases)

- Bump to 1.1.0  
    Settings added since 1.0.3 are marked new in 1.1.0.  
- Fade enemy targets that are out of range for hunters  
    Raptor Strike answers in range at any distance, so it no longer counts as a range check and enemy targets fade past Auto Shot range. A hidden party range answer is now handed to the frame as it is.  
- Polish the options and installer and reach them with a controller  
    Escape in a confirm dialog closes only the dialog. Resetting frame positions asks first, greyed out settings cannot be reset, and Reset Section counts only settings that changed. Buttons grey out with the setting they need, the slider box always shows the real value, and the Changed list has a way back. Profile import checks the pasted text before asking for a name and keeps it when the name is taken. The installer says when combat or the game refused a change, starts every tweak unticked and uses plain wording.  
    With the Gamepad UI on, the loot window and loot rolls use the game's own gamepad frames, the bag, bank, options, installer and dialog windows can be reached with B to close, and skinned buttons show the controller focus.  
    Colours come from the palette throughout, placeholder text is easier to read, buttons show a pressed state, and comments were tidied.  
- Fix bugs found in a code review  
    One module erroring no longer stops other modules hearing the event. Profile export reports a failed compression. Cancelling the colour picker keeps the old colour. Edit boxes in the options only save a real change. Secret values are guarded in the GCD bar, group tools, tooltip and threat paths. Hide In Combat now hides tooltips placed by the default anchor, and test mode ends when combat starts.  
- Colour levels by difficulty and add a threat readout on the target  
    Unit frames, nameplates and tooltips share one difficulty colour for the levels of units you can attack, and enemy health uses the game's own reaction colour. The target frame can show your share of its threat at the left end of the health bar.  
- Expand the minimap performance readout  
    The readout colours the framerate, shows both latencies and the instance lockouts in its tooltip, and redraws only when a value changes. Minimap buttons stay put in combat and lay out again once it ends.  
- Stop quest automation retrying quests it cannot finish  
    A quest the game refuses, for full bags or missing gold, is held and passed over until something changes, so the next quest in the list still gets its turn.  
- Let bag sections be reordered and turned off  
    The bag sections panel can move sections and groups up and down and switch any of them off, so their items fall through to the next section. Special bags such as quivers and soul bags get their own free slot buttons, and the backpack shows the general free slots.  
- Show the inspected player's item level  
    The inspect window shows the player's average item level, read again as their gear loads, and the gear info updates only for the item that is still in the slot.  
- Add chat emojis, a characters left count and new chat bubbles  
    Smileys like :) and shortcodes like :heart: or :mage: show as small icons in player chat, and copy back as the typed text. The edit box shows how many characters are left. Chat bubbles are compact, show the speaker above the text and can tint by chat type. Channel names shorten after a line is stored, so history replays stay intact, and links open through the game's own handler.  
- Add max camera distance and double right-click fishing  
    Max Camera Distance raises the camera to the top of the game's own slider. Easy Fishing casts Fishing on a double right-click in the world. The Profession Tabs option is removed.  
- Draw unexplored map areas without tainting the map  
    The map reveal now draws after the game's own exploration overlays and only takes its hook while the option is on, so the world map and its pins stay free of addon taint. It also no longer errors at login before the map has loaded.  
- Add /way and Alt+click map waypoints  
    Type /way 45 60 for a waypoint in your zone, /way Westfall 45 60 for another zone, or /way clear to remove it. Alt+click on the world map does the same. Both set the game's own tracked waypoint.  
- Move the swing timer to its own bars and movers  
    Main hand, off hand and ranged swings each get their own bar and mover, with a spark, an optional draining fill and a dimmed bar when the target is out of reach. The options moved from the player frame to a Swing Timer page under Unit Frames.  
- Add comet, ribbon and particle styles to the cursor trail  
    The trail picks from several art styles shown as small previews in the options, can fade into a second tail colour, and tapers, drifts and twinkles as it fades. Everything but the enable switch and the pool size applies straight away.  
- Show loss of control and flyout procs on action buttons  
    A stun or silence that outlasts a cooldown now shows its own swipe, a flyout glows when a spell inside it procs, and vehicle and mount changes update the checked state. Combat-only bars no longer stay hidden for the first moment of a fight. Hotkey text shortens every modifier and mouse button the same way in every locale.  
- Snap movers to each other and to a grid, with undo  
    Move mode snaps a dragged frame to the screen centre, to the edges of nearby movers and to an optional grid, with guide lines and the snapped neighbour lit. Hold Shift to place a frame freely. Ctrl+Z undoes the last move, arrow keys nudge the hovered frame by one pixel or ten with Shift, and every position lands on a whole pixel. The panel holds the snap and grid switches and the grid step, and Escape closes move mode.

# KkthnxUI Forever

## [1.0.3](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/tree/1.0.3) (2026-11-22)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/compare/1.0.2...1.0.3) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/releases)

- Bump to 1.0.3  
- Line up the inspect window with the character window and use new class backgrounds  
    The inspect window now has the character window's height, slot positions and spacing, and it no longer overlaps the character window when both are open. The wide character layout is applied when Blizzard resizes the window instead of every frame. Both windows use new darker class backgrounds, and the unused backgrounds for classes not on Forever are removed.  
- Listen to unit events only for the units that matter  
    Modules can now register unit events filtered by the game. Reminders, the GCD bar and the bag quest refresh no longer run for every nameplate and raid member.  
- Make the mana tick spark work with protected mana values  
    Forever keeps the player's mana value protected, so the spark could never spot a regen tick. A power update that none of your own casts explains is now taken as the tick, and the beat rules still filter out stray gains.  
- Colour dispellable debuffs by type on party and raid frames  
    Forever has no DebuffTypeColor table, so every dispellable debuff showed the neutral white border. The colours now come from the game's per type debuff colours.  
- Show empty pet bar slots instead of gaps  
    Blizzard hides a pet button with no action, which left holes in the pet bar. Each slot now has an empty backing like the other bars when Show Empty Button Grid is on.  
- Keep the leave vehicle button skinned and put it beside bar 1  
    Blizzard reset the button's highlight on every update and after a flight path landing click, so ours is put back each time. The button now defaults to the right end of bar 1 at that bar's button size and spacing, and can still be moved.  
- Use the Delve arrow for flyout buttons  
    The flyout arrow is now the gold Delve arrow, turned to match the direction each bar opens its flyouts, and centred on the button edge.  
- Stop flyout buttons erroring when they are built  
    Forever rejects a secure wrap without a pre-handler body, so every flyout button threw when it was created and the flyout never closed after a cast. The wrap now passes a body that lets the close run.

# KkthnxUI Forever

## [1.0.2](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/tree/1.0.2) (2026-11-22)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/compare/1.0.1...1.0.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Kkthnx-Wow/KkthnxUI-Forever/releases)

- Bump to 1.0.2  
- Skin What's Training tooltips and leave other addons' tooltips alone  
    Our tooltip skin hid the background art of every tooltip built from the  
    game's tooltip template, including other addons' tooltips it never styled,  
    which left them with no background at all. It now only touches tooltips it  
    skinned, and What's Training's own tooltips get the KkthnxUI skin.  
- Keep the bag free slot tooltip up while hovered  
    The free slot button is an item button on an empty slot, and the game's own  
    tooltip refresh for it found nothing and closed the tooltip at once. The  
    tooltip now belongs to the frame the button sits in, so it stays up and  
    closes when the pointer leaves.  
- Match the mail buttons to the mail frame and make Take All safe  
    Collect Gold and Take All now use the mail frame's own red buttons. Collect  
    Gold sits under the Inbox title instead of covering the Next page button, and  
    is greyed out when no gold is waiting. Take All joins the Reply, Delete and  
    Cancel row. It skips COD mail, which Blizzard always asks about before paying,  
    and stops if the mail it was emptying is replaced by the next one. The  
    attachment list on an inbox row now shows every item the first time, even  
    ones the game has not cached.  
- Strip the objective tracker skin down to text  
    The quest tracker drops its header bars and uses our font, our collapse  
    chevron, our border on quest item buttons, and one calm colour for progress  
    and timer bars. It stays clear of the tracker's own update, the scenario  
    module and the shared widget pool, and writes no field Blizzard reads, so the  
    tracker keeps updating after a reload.  
- Remove Copy Name from player menus  
    Adding an entry to the player right click menu taints how the menu is built.  
    With the Gamepad UI on, opening the target menu from the gamepad bar then  
    failed with "Interface action failed because of an AddOn". The option is gone  
    until it can be added without touching the menu.  
- Keep party debuffs on the frame and range check hunters in melee  
    Party and raid debuff rows start at the bottom corner of the health bar, so a  
    second row no longer rises above the frame. Hunters get Raptor Strike as a  
    melee range probe, since Auto Shot has a minimum range and Wing Clip is only  
    learned at level 12.  
- Tint nameplate debuff shadows by dispel school  
    A nameplate debuff now glows in its dispel school's colour through its own  
    soft shadow, and a debuff with no school keeps the plain black shadow. This  
    replaces the thin coloured edges, which drew as ragged bars. The elite and  
    rare marker sits at the left end of the health bar instead of floating away  
    from short names.  
- Use one 6 pixel gap across the interface  
    Bags, the chat bar, collected minimap buttons, profession tabs, gear info  
    icons and the bag window's clearance from the side bars now share the same  
    6 pixel gap. Player and target frames are 218 pixels and focus 204, so a full  
    row of aura icons ends flush with the frame. Nameplates are 154 pixels with  
    26 pixel debuffs, which fill the plate exactly.  
- Run the action bars on our own button library  
    The action bars now use LibActionButtonKit, a small secure action button  
    library written for KkthnxUI, in place of LibActionButton.  
    - Casting, paging with forms, stealth and vehicles, and drag and drop all  
      run in secure code, so the bars keep working in combat.  
    - Cooldowns use the client's duration objects, so they stay correct when the  
      game hides cooldown values.  
    - Mouse clicks always cast on release, so picking a spell up never casts it,  
      while key presses still follow the cast on key press setting.  
    - Flyouts open from the bar's own secure flyout and close on any other  
      action, a page change, or when their bar hides. A mouseover bar stays shown  
      while the pointer is on its flyout.  
    - /kkdebug actioncd reads the cooldown values the buttons get from the game.
